summary: Disaster Desk: watched 4 Shorts (Titan, Kobe Bryant's helicopter, Tacoma Narrows, Colgan Air). The second beat (3–8 s) is the biggest drop in every measured Short, so lesson 0 is raised with three new videos and a sharper fix; one ending test added.
why: Beat-2 drops: Titan −21.1% at 7.0 s (sub replaced by a flat sonar diagram, 'So what happened?'), Kobe −16.6% at 5.2 s (helicopter a speck over desert hills, figures late), Tacoma −31.3% at 5.5 s (backstory, 39 views). Titan also lost 16.4% in its 7 s question-and-pointer ending, which is the champion recipe, so it goes to the loop as a test.

findings.title: Second beat is the biggest drop in 5 of 5 measured Shorts
findings.detail: Titan −21.1% at 7.0 s, Kobe −16.6% at 5.2 s, Tacoma −31.3% at 5.5 s, tanker −15.5% at 5.3 s, Lac-Mégantic −11.3% at 5.4 s.

findings.title: Titan's 7 s ending lost 16.4%
findings.detail: 'The company or the rules… Full story on our channel' at 48.5 s; end hold 15%.

findings.title: Colgan Air (first Short after lesson 0) still ends beat 2 on a question
findings.detail: No retention yet; check its 5–10 s drop on Tuesday.

changes.title: Raised lesson 0 (second beat stays on the subject)
changes.detail: Added Titan, Kobe and Tacoma; the fix now bans pull-outs, early diagrams, stalling questions and backstory in the 3–8 s beat.

changes.title: Challenger dd-short-promo-end
changes.detail: A 2 s closing pointer against the 5–7 s question-and-pointer loop beat.
